newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt seeks bids for 50,000T optional wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt seeks bids for 50,000T optional wheat.

text.p: The Egyptian state's General Authority for Supply Commodities (GASC) said on Thursday it was inviting bids for 50,000 tonnes of U.S., French, Australian or Argentine wheat for shipment in January of February.
The deadline for bids is 0700 GMT on Saturday, December 7, and bids should be valid until 1100 GMT on Monday, GASC chairman Samir Shakankiri told Reuters.
"The authority reserves the right to cancel this tender without giving any reason," he added.
He said GASC was looking for any type of U.S. wheat, soft red French wheat, standard soft while Australian wheat or Argentine wheat.
Shipment date will be at buyer's option, Shakankiri said.
